user.title: Rain Sense
user.description: Share a rain sensor with a friend, or receive one that a friend shares with you.

send.title: Entities to share
send.description: Choose the entities your friend should get. They are shared read-only.

link.title: Your sharing link
link.description:
Send this link to your friend. Anyone with the link can read the chosen entities, so keep it private.

`{link}`

The address in front must be reachable from your friend's Home Assistant (see the README). Change it if needed, the rest of the link stays the same.

receive.title: Receive a shared sensor
receive.description: Paste the link your friend sent you.

error.cannot_connect: The link could not be reached or does not belong to Rain Sense.

abort.already_configured: This link is already set up.
